description: Na₂PdF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six F¹⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-68°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.40 Å. Pd²⁺ is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F¹⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Pd-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Pd²⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Pd trigonal pyramids. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Pd²⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Pd tetrahedra.
